latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Support OpenSSL 4.x by @neverpanic in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/50
* fix undefined behavior (which resulted in running out of memory) by @tihmstar in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/34
* Enable support for keys obtained through PKCS#11 by @CRKatri in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/38
* Allow for specifying an arbitrary Team ID by @alfiecg24 in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/36
* replace UI_UTIL_read_pw_string with EVP_read_pw_string by @Un1q32 in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/44
* Don't try to sign dSYM companion files by @CRKatri in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/47
* Fix error message typo by @TheRealKeto in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/30
* Fix error message typos by @Jah-yee in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/48

## New Contributors
* @tihmstar made their first contribution in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/34
* @alfiecg24 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/36
* @Un1q32 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/44
* @Jah-yee made their first contribution in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/48
* @neverpanic made their first contribution in https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/pull/50

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ProcursusTeam/ldid/compare/v2.1.5-procursus7...v2.1.5-procursus8

detail.readme:
# ldid

Changes from https://git.saurik.com/ldid.git:
- Add manpages (`en`, `zh_TW` and `zh_CN`) (@CRKatri & @asdfugil)
- Support OpenSSL 3 (@sunflsks)
- Allow p12 keys to have a password (@sunflsks)
- Add a `-arch arch_type` flag so that typing the raw CPU type is not needed
- Proper error messages
- Load key using PKCS#11
